```{ojs}
chart2 = {
  const colors = [
    "#ff3399",
    "hotpink",
    "hsl(330, 100%, 70.5%)",
    "rgba(128, 0, 128, 0.2)"
  ];

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", 320)
    .attr("height", 60);

  const rects = svg.selectAll("rect")
    .data(colors)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", (_, i) => i * 55)
      .attr("y", 10)
      .attr("width", 50)
      .attr("height", 40)
      .attr("rx", 1)
      .attr("fill", d => d);

  function animate() {
    rects
      .interrupt() // stop any running transition
      .attr("opacity", 0)
      .attr("transform", "translate(-5,0)")
      .transition()
      .delay((_, i) => i * 400)
      .duration(500)
      .ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .attr("opacity", 1)
      .attr("transform", "translate(0,0)");
  }

  animate(); // run immediately

  const timer = d3.interval(animate, 4000);

  // Clean up when the cell is invalidated
  invalidation.then(() => timer.stop());

  return svg.node();
}
```

```{ojs}
import { aq, op } from '@uwdata/arquero'
```

```{ojs}
categories = d3.schemeTableau10
  .filter((c, i) => i !== 2)
  .map(c => opacity(d3.color(c).brighter(), 0.3))
```

```{ojs}
opacity = (c, value) => {
  c = d3.color(c);
  c.opacity = value;
  return c + '';
}
```

```{ojs}
call = (arg, prefix, suffix = '') => {
  const elem = [md`&mdash; \`${prefix}(\``, arg, md`\`${suffix})\` ⟶`];
  const span = html`<span></span>`;
  
  elem.forEach(e => {
    e.style.display = 'inline-block';
    e.style.verticalAlign = 'top';
    e.style.marginRight = '0.4em';
    span.appendChild(e);
  });
  
  return span;
}
```

```{ojs}
function hconcat(...elem) {
  const span = html`<span></span>`;

  elem.forEach(e => {
    e.style.display = 'inline-block';
    e.style.verticalAlign = 'top';
    e.style.marginRight = '1em';
    span.appendChild(e);
  });

  return span;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const l = aq.table({ 
    id1: [1, 2, 3], 
    date: ["2025-04-03", "2025-05-03", "2025-08-24"] 
  });

  const r = aq.table({ 
    id2: [1, 6, 3], 
    subtype: ["H1", "H3", "H5"] 
  });

  // simulated fuzzy join result
  const j = aq.table({
    id: [1, 2, 3], 
    date: ["2025-04-03", "2025-05-03", "2025-08-24"] ,
    subtype: ["H1", null, "H5"] 
    // score: [1.0, 0.89]
  });

  const [cl, cr] = categories;

  const color = (f, c) => (i, r) =>
    i < 0 || j.get(f, r) == null ? null : c;

  const format = v => v == null ? '∅' : v + '';

  const opt = {
    color: {
        id: color('id', cl),
        date: color('date', cl),
        subtype: color('subtype', cr)
    },
    format: {
      id1: format,
      date: format,
      id2: format,
      subtype: format,
    //   score: format
    }
  };

  const container = html`<div style="text-align:center;"></div>`;

  container.appendChild(
    hconcat(
      l.view({ color: i => i < 0 ? null : cl }),
      call(r.view({ color: i => i < 0 ? null : cr }), ""),
      j.view(opt)
    )
  );

  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
main_pkg = {
  const colors = [
    "#ff3399",
    "hotpink",
    "hsl(330, 100%, 70.5%)",
    "rgba(128, 0, 128, 0.2)"
  ];

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .attr("height", 280)
    .attr("viewBox", "0 0 800 280");

  const squareSize = 100;
  const gap = 20;
  const totalWidth = colors.length * squareSize + (colors.length - 1) * gap;
  const startX = (800 - totalWidth) / 2;

  svg.selectAll("rect")
    .data(colors)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", (_, i) => startX + i * (squareSize + gap))
      .attr("y", 60)
      .attr("width", squareSize)
      .attr("height", squareSize)
      .attr("rx", 4)
      .attr("fill", d => d);

  // Annotation line
  const firstX = startX + squareSize / 2;

  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", firstX)
    .attr("y1", 170)
    .attr("x2", firstX)
    .attr("y2", 210)
    .attr("stroke", "#555")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3);

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", firstX)
    .attr("y", 240)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", '"Maple Mono", monospace')
    .attr("font-size", 24)
    .attr("fill", "#555")
    .text("Main package");

  return svg.node();
}
```

## wadoh_raccoon

```{ojs}
base = {
  const colors = [
    "#ff3399",
    "hotpink",
    "hsl(330, 100%, 70.5%)",
    "rgba(128, 0, 128, 0.2)"
  ];

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .attr("height", 280)
    .attr("viewBox", "0 0 900 280");

  const size = 100;
  const y = 100;

  // Main package
  const mainX = 100;

  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("x", mainX)
    .attr("y", y)
    .attr("width", size)
    .attr("height", size)
    .attr("rx", 4)
    .attr("fill", colors[0]);

  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", mainX + size)
    .attr("y1", y + size / 2)
    .attr("x2", 350)
    .attr("y2", y + size / 2)
    .attr("stroke", "#999")
    .attr("stroke-width", 2);

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", mainX + size / 2)
    .attr("y", 245)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", '"Maple Mono", monospace')
    .attr("font-size", 22)
    .attr("fill", "#555")
    .text("wadoh_raccoon");

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", mainX + size / 2)
    .attr("y", 270)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", '"Maple Mono", monospace')
    .attr("font-size", 16)
    .attr("fill", "#888")
    .text("Main py package");


  // Dependent projects
  const projects = [
    {name: "project1", color: colors[1]},
    {name: "project2", color: colors[2]},
    {name: "project3", color: colors[3]}
  ];

  projects.forEach((p, i) => {
    const x = 350 + i * 160;

    // label above
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", x + size / 2)
      .attr("y", 60)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-family", '"Maple Mono", monospace')
      .attr("font-size", 18)
      .attr("fill", "#555")
      .text(p.name);

    // square
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", x)
      .attr("y", y)
      .attr("width", size)
      .attr("height", size)
      .attr("rx", 4)
      .attr("fill", p.color);
  });

  return svg.node();
}
```

- If you need to reuse code more than 2x, put it in a function
- If you reuse it across projects, put it in a package
- Ensures that you use the exact same methods in every project
- Saves hella time

```{python}
#| eval: false

# run ID matching - join to

respnet_explode = (
    pull_res.respnet
```

## RESP-NET Subtyping

:::{.incremental}
- Pipeline to link subtyping data 
- Labs send subtype data to LIMS
- Pulls data from LIMS
- Links data to disease reporting database (WDRS)
:::

```{python}
#| eval: false

import random
# Get unique IDs
unique_ids = rm_na.select("PHLAccessionNumber").unique()

# Generate random replacement IDs
random.seed(42)  # optional, for reproducibility

id_map = unique_ids.with_columns(
    pl.Series(
        "censored_id",
        [random.randint(100000, 999999) for _ in range(unique_ids.height)]
    )
)

# Replace identifiers using the mapping
df_censored = (
    rm_na.join(id_map, on="PHLAccessionNumber")
      .drop("PHLAccessionNumber")
      .rename({"censored_id": "PHLAccessionNumber"})
      .unique()
      .with_columns(
        pl.col('PHLAccessionNumber').cast(pl.String)
      )
)

df_censored.write_csv('censored.csv')
```

```{ojs}
//| eval: true
//| echo: false

// Function to compute density
function kernelDensityEstimator(kernel, X) {
  return function(V) {
    return X.map(function(x) {
      return [x, d3.mean(V, function(v) { return kernel(x - v); })];
    });
  };
}

```

```{ojs}
//| eval: true
//| echo: false

function kernelEpanechnikov(k) {
  return function(v) {
    return Math.abs(v /= k) <= 1 ? 0.75 * (1 - v * v) / k : 0;
  };
}

```

```{ojs}
//| eval: true
//| echo: false

data = FileAttachment("censored.csv").csv()
  .then(rows => rows.map(d => ({
    id: +d.PHLAccessionNumber,
    outcome: d.stage,
    days: +d.days
  })))

chart = {

  // Specify the chart’s dimensions.
  const width = 1200;
  // const height = 600;
  const marginTop = 50;
  const marginRight = 40;
  const marginBottom = 35;
  const marginLeft = 100;

  // const densityHeight = 200;   // top area
  // const boxplotHeight = 150;   // bottom area

  const densityHeight = 200;
  const gap = -40;
  const boxplotHeight = 220;

const boxTop = densityHeight + gap;
const height = boxTop + boxplotHeight + marginBottom;

  // Define the horizontal scale.
  const x = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([0, 100])
    .range([marginLeft, width - marginRight]);

  const y = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 0.12])
      .range([densityHeight, marginTop]);

  const filteredData = data.filter(d => {
    const group = data
      .filter(x => x.outcome === d.outcome)
      .map(x => x.days)
      .sort(d3.ascending);
  
    const q1 = d3.quantile(group, 0.25);
    const q3 = d3.quantile(group, 0.75);
    const iqr = q3 - q1;
  
    const lower = q1 - 1.5 * iqr;
    const upper = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
  
    return d.days >= lower && d.days <= upper;
  });

  // Make the boxplot stats 
  // Compute quartiles, median, inter quantile range min and max --> these info are then used to draw the box.
  const sumstat = d3.rollups(
  filteredData,
  v => {
    const values = v.map(d => d.days).sort(d3.ascending);

    const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25);
    const median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5);
    const q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
    const iqr = q3 - q1;

    return {
      q1,
      median,
      q3,
      iqr,
      min: Math.max(d3.min(values), q1 - 1.5 * iqr),
      max: Math.min(d3.max(values), q3 + 1.5 * iqr)
    };
  },
  d => d.outcome
).map(([outcome, stats]) => ({
  outcome,
  ...stats
}));

  // Color scale
  const myColor = d3.scaleSequential()
    .interpolator(d3.interpolateInferno)
    .domain([4,8])

  const colors = d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([
      "reporting_days",
      "processing_days",
      "transit_days"
    ])
    .range([
      "#56B4E9",
      "#3F51B5",
      "#E68653"
    ]);

  const outcomes = ["processing_days", "transit_days", "reporting_days"];

  const yCategory = d3.scaleBand()
  .domain(outcomes)
  .range([0, boxplotHeight])
  .paddingInner(0.5)
  .paddingOuter(0.8);
  

  // Create the container SVG.
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "width: 100%; height: auto;");

  const densityGroup = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,0)`);
  
  const densityBottom = densityHeight + 10;

const boxGroup = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${densityBottom + gap})`);

  // Add the axes.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));

// Compute kernel density estimation
  // const kde = kernelDensityEstimator(kernelEpanechnikov(7), x.ticks(60))
  const values = filteredData.map(d => d.days);

  // const kde = kernelDensityEstimator(
  //   kernelEpanechnikov(7),
  //   d3.range(
  //     d3.min(values),
  //     d3.max(values),
  //     1
  //   )
  // );
  const kde = kernelDensityEstimator(
    kernelEpanechnikov(3),
    d3.range(0, 101, 1)
  );
  const density1 =  kde( filteredData
      .filter( function(d){return d.outcome === "reporting_days"} )
      .map(function(d){  return d.days; }) )
      .filter(d => d[0] >= 0 && d[0] <= 100);
  const density2 =  kde( filteredData
      .filter( function(d){return d.outcome === "processing_days"} )
      .map(function(d){  return d.days; }) )
  .filter(d => d[0] >= 0 && d[0] <= 100);
  const density3 =  kde( filteredData
      .filter( function(d){return d.outcome === "transit_days"} )
      .map(function(d){  return d.days; }) )
  .filter(d => d[0] >= 0 && d[0] <= 100);


  // Append a circle for each data point.

  // Plot the area
  densityGroup.append("path")
    .datum(density1)
    .attr("fill", d => colors("reporting_days"))
    .attr("opacity", 0.6)
    .attr("stroke", "#000")
    .attr("d", d3.area()
      .curve(d3.curveLinear)
      .x(d => x(d[0]))
      .y0(y(0))
      .y1(d => y(d[1]))
    );

  // Plot the area
  densityGroup.append("path")
      .attr("class", "mypath")
      .datum(density2)
      .attr("fill", d => colors("processing_days"))
      .attr("opacity", ".6")
      .attr("stroke", "#000")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
      .attr("stroke-linejoin", "round")
      .attr("d", d3.area()
        .curve(d3.curveLinear)
        .x(d => x(d[0]))
        .y0(y(0))
        .y1(d => y(d[1]))
      );

  densityGroup.append("path")
      .attr("class", "mypath")
      .datum(density3)
      .attr("fill", d => colors("transit_days"))
      .attr("opacity", ".6")
      .attr("stroke", "#000")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
      .attr("stroke-linejoin", "round")
      .attr("d", d3.area()
        .curve(d3.curveLinear)
        .x(d => x(d[0]))
        .y0(y(0))
        .y1(d => y(d[1]))
      );

  // make the boxes smaller height
  const boxHeight = yCategory.bandwidth() - 10;
  const boxOffset = 5; // centers the shorter box within the band

  boxGroup.selectAll(".box")
  .data(sumstat)
  .enter()
  .append("rect")
  .attr("class", "box")
  .attr("x", d => x(d.q1))
  .attr("width", d => x(d.q3) - x(d.q1))
  .attr("y", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset)
  .attr("height", boxHeight)
  .attr("stroke", "black")
  .style("fill", d => colors(d.outcome))
  .style("opacity", 0.5);

  boxGroup.selectAll(".median")
  .data(sumstat)
  .enter()
  .append("line")
  .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))
  .attr("x2", d => x(d.median))
  .attr("y1", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset)
  .attr("y2", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight)
  .attr("stroke", "black")
  .attr("stroke-width", 2);

  boxGroup.selectAll(".leftWhisker")
  .data(sumstat)
  .enter()
  .append("line")
  .attr("x1", d => x(d.min))
  .attr("x2", d => x(d.q1))
  .attr("y1", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight / 2)
  .attr("y2", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight / 2)
  .attr("stroke", "black");

boxGroup.selectAll(".rightWhisker")
  .data(sumstat)
  .enter()
  .append("line")
  .attr("x1", d => x(d.q3))
  .attr("x2", d => x(d.max))
  .attr("y1", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight / 2)
  .attr("y2", d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight / 2)
  .attr("stroke", "black");

  // add data points

  const pointY = d => yCategory(d.outcome) + boxOffset + boxHeight + 8;

  const pointGap = 10;       // distance below box
  const pointSpread = 10;    // vertical jitter height

  filteredData.forEach(d => {
    d.jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * pointSpread;
  });

  boxGroup.selectAll(".point")
  .data(filteredData)
  .enter()
  .append("circle")
  .attr("class", "point")
  .attr("cx", d => x(d.days))
  .attr("cy", d =>
    yCategory(d.outcome) +
    boxOffset +
    boxHeight +
    pointGap +
    d.jitter
  )
  .attr("r", 2.5)
  .attr("fill", d => colors(d.outcome))
  .attr("opacity", 0.6);

  

const legend = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${width - 170},25)`);

const legendItems = [
  {label: "Reporting", outcome: "reporting_days"},
  {label: "Processing", outcome: "processing_days"},
  {label: "Transit", outcome: "transit_days"}
];

const item = legend.selectAll("g")
  .data(legendItems)
  .enter()
  .append("g")
  .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 22})`);

item.append("rect")
  .attr("width", 14)
  .attr("height", 14)
  .attr("fill", d => colors(d.outcome));

item.append("text")
  .attr("x", 20)
  .attr("y", 11)
  .style("font-size", "20px")
  .text(d => d.label);




  return svg.node();
}

```

## DIQA

- Query problems
- Labs not sending demographics (no way to roster a record without it)
- Chelsea found a medical record number that allowed us to match them
- Went months without rostering many of these data
- this plot shows that infra for sending and physically analyzing samples is standardized and battle tested
- however, it shows that on the data side, the lack of data infrastructure, database management, and data standardization has led to a data modernization failure. 
- if public health needs fast insights, I believe this is where the bottle neck will be - **the bottle neck isn't getting a subtype, it's putting that subtype data into a databse!
**

- Solutions: we need variable definitions
- we need identifiers (matching on demographics will always be sketchy and have problems)
- No amount of modernizing cloud infra will solve this. 
- Data modernization needs to have data standards at the forefront of the conversation. Without it, it doesn't matter how well you write code 
or how much data you can process. You will miss records because you cannot account for all scenarios (like labs putting numbers in the first name column)

```python
from wadoh_raccoon import dataframe_matcher as dfm

fuzzy_init = dfm.DataFrameMatcher(
    df_src=w_res.submissions_to_fuzzy, 
    df_ref=pull_res.respnet,
    first_name=('PatientFirstName', 'FIRST_NAME'),
    last_name=('PatientLastName', 'LAST_NAME'),
    dob=('PatientBirthDate','BIRTH_DATE'),
    spec_col_date=('SpecimenDateCollected', 'SPECIMEN_COLLECTION_DTTM'),
    key='submission_number',
    threshold=80  # set what kind of fuzzy threshold you want, 100 being exact match
)

result=fuzzy_init.match()
```
